method: retinal histology of hatchlings, with behavioural correlates
conditions: hatchlings of Chelonia mydas, Caretta caretta and Dermochelys coriacea

source.title: Comparative studies of retinal design among sea turtles: histological and behavioral correlates of the visual streak

where: abstract (FAU repository record, read through a summariser, quote given in two consecutive pieces split after 'visual streak')
quote: Three species of sea turtles (Chelonia mydas, Caretta caretta, and Dermochelys coriacea) possess a visual streak located along the horizontal mid-line of the retina, although they differed in streak development.
note: Abstract only. It names a streak in the loggerhead and says streak development differed among the three species; it gives no fovea, ganglion cell density or acuity.
